title: atlcli.export-report/1
description: The stable machine-readable report emitted by `atlcli wiki export` under --json / --report json. Additive changes only; a breaking change bumps the schema string. Note the one widening within /1: issue.severity gained `info` when severity started honouring the engine note level, so informational notes stopped inflating `warnings[]` and `--strict`.

engine.description: Current producers emit `ts`; `python` remains accepted so archived atlcli.export-report/1 documents stay valid.

codeTheme.description: Effective bundled Shiki theme used for code blocks.

sourcePages.description: One entry per source page — provenance/fetch-and-compose status only, NO per-page metrics.

outputDetails.description: One entry per compiled artifact (outputs[]). Per-artifact metrics live here, never invented per-sourcePages fields. Exactly one entry per scope today (artifact-cardinality contract).

issues.description: Every issue, at every severity. There is no `infos` convenience view — read severity==info off here or off notesByCode.

warnings.description: Convenience view: issues with severity==warning. Informational notes are NOT included (they were, before severity honoured the engine note level).

exitCode.description: 0 success; 1 usage/config/IO; 2 strict warnings; 3 auth; 4 remote/API; 5 compile/validate; 130 cancelled.

requestedScope.description: The scope as requested by flags (spec 002 traceability).

resolvedScope.description: The resolved scope (e.g. a space request resolved to a tree rooted at the homepage id).

complete.description: False when the composed document omitted content (partial mode).

severity.description: `info` mirrors an engine note with level==info (an observation about a correct export). Added in the same change that made severity honour the note level; a consumer pinned to an older copy of this file must widen its enum.

details.description: Structured payload for typed errors (affected pages, budget offenders, ...).
